annotations.claim: RAGEval introduces three novel metrics: Completeness, Hallucination, and Irrelevance.
Experimental results show RAGEval outperforms zero‑shot and one‑shot methods in clarity, safety, conformity, and richness of generated samples.
Deepchecks provides a robust foundation for assessing reliability, relevance, and user satisfaction in RAG systems.
EvaRAG evaluates RAG configurations by systematically varying retrievers, indexing methods, similarity metrics, and rerankers across small, medium, and large datasets.
The HNSW–IP–Fusion–minilm configuration achieves Coverage Retrieval 0.942, Correctness 0.909, and Faithfulness 0.970.
The IVF–L2–Hierarchical configuration demonstrates the lowest latency of 1.736 ns and lowest cost.
RAGe supports rapid prototyping even on consumer‑grade hardware.
EncouRAGe comprises five modular components: Type Manifest, RAG Factory, Inference, Vector Store, and Metrics.
Hybrid BM25 consistently achieves the best results across all four datasets, while reranking yields only marginal improvements with higher latency.
Semantic stratification grounds retrieval evaluation in corpus structure by organizing documents into entity‑based clusters and generating queries for missing strata.
Meta evaluation verifies that RAGChecker has significantly worse correlations with human judgments than other evaluation metrics.

Findings on the interplay of THELMA metrics can be interpreted to identify the specific RAG component needing improvement in QA applications, and these results were replicated on three additional datasets.

EvaRAG proposes a benchmarking framework that systematically varies retrievers, indexing methods, similarity metrics, and rerankers over datasets of three scales, outperforming the strongest baseline by 12%.
The IVF–L2–Hierarchical configuration demonstrates the lowest latency of 2.736 ns and lowest cost.

RAGEval generates scenario‑specific evaluation data by producing high‑quality documents, questions, answers, and references through a schema‑based pipeline, as confirmed by a user study with 200 participants.
